LanguageData.CC_Shelf_ButtonDesc: Keep a slot on this shelf for each kind you pick, so there's always one stack of each the colony has. The other slots take anything the shelf allows.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_Explain: The slots below are kept for their kinds while the colony has some on this map, each filled by a stack of its own. A reserved kind is brought from loose stacks and from storage of this shelf's priority or lower, never from storage of a higher priority. Any meals or medicine fill their slots best first, in the order colonists pick them: a better kind that turns up takes a lesser stack's slot, and the lesser goes back to the store. Haulers fill the other slots with anything the shelf allows; when a reserved kind turns up and the shelf is full, a stack of what it holds most of is carried elsewhere to make room, or set down beside the shelf when nothing else takes it. A colonist told to haul a reserved kind to a full shelf makes room first. The shelf's storage settings still decide what it may hold.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_Off: Reserved slots are switched off in Rimfolk's settings (Building page), or the deeper game hooks are, so haulers don't keep to these for now.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_Coming: on the map, comes to the free slot
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_MakingRoom: on the map, a stack moves out to make room
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_NoneOnMap: none on this map, its slot is used meanwhile
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_KeptHigher: on the map, but only in storage of a higher priority than this shelf, which keeps it
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_BetterComing: on the shelf, the {BETTER} comes in place of the {LESSER}
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_RemoveTip: No longer reserve a slot for this
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_KeepTip: Reserve a slot for each kind the shelf holds now that has none yet.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_SomeHere: {0} of {1} on the shelf, the rest {REST}
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_FullTip: Every slot of the shelf is reserved already
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_OnlyTip: Ticked, the shelf holds no more stacks of this than its slots, even with room to spare. A stack added to one already there still goes in.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_PerStackTip: The most of this in one stack on the shelf. Haulers top a stack up to it and bring no more; a bigger stack already there is used up first, not carried off.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_WhenPatient: While a patient lies in this room
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_WhenTip: When this is kept on the shelf. "While a patient lies in this room": only while someone lies ill or hurt in a bed in the shelf's room. Otherwise it isn't kept here at all, and what is here is carried elsewhere.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_WhenOff: not now: no patient in this room
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_WhenNoRoom: never: the shelf isn't in a room
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_MakeRoomHaul: Make room on the {SHELF} and haul {THING} there
LanguageData.CC_ShelfPick_Sub: Click to reserve a slot, click again to take it off. How many slots each keeps is set in the shelf's list.
LanguageData.CC_ShelfPick_AnyTip: A slot for any of the {GROUP}: whichever comes first fills it.
LanguageData.CC_ShelfPick_AnyBestFirstTip: A slot for any of the {GROUP}, the best first, in the order colonists pick them: a lavish meal before a fine one, a simple meal before a survival pack, glitterworld medicine before industrial. A better kind that turns up takes a lesser stack's slot, and the lesser goes back to the store. What colonists don't eat as a meal (drinks, desserts, food eaten only when starving) comes last.
LanguageData.CC_ShelfPick_BestTip: A slot for the best of the {GROUP} the colony has at hand, in the order colonists pick them: a lavish meal before a fine one, a simple meal before a survival pack, glitterworld medicine before industrial. Drinks, desserts and food eaten only when starving don't count. When a better kind turns up, it takes the slot, and the lesser stack may move out to make room.
